# Mat Hayward

> Landscape and travel photography by Mat Hayward, a photographer based in the Trossachs, Scotland. Galleries from Scotland and further afield, maps of the locations where photos were taken, and short write-ups of mountains climbed.

Mat also writes [Slow Scotland](https://slowscotland.uk), a free 12-week email journey through Scotland’s quieter places.

## Photography

- [Chamonix](https://mathayward.com/photography/chamonix/): Photography from around the Chamonix valley including Balcon Nord, Balcon Sud and Aiguille du Midi
- [Madeira](https://mathayward.com/photography/madeira/): Photography from around Madeira including Pico Ruivo, Pico do Arieiro and Bica da Cana
- [Iceland](https://mathayward.com/photography/iceland/): Photography from Southern Iceland, including Stokksnes, Þórsmörk and Reynisfjara.
- [Swiss Alps](https://mathayward.com/photography/switzerland/): Photography from around Switzerland, including Schäfler Ridge, Oeschinen Lake, and the Matterhorn.
- [Dolomites](https://mathayward.com/photography/dolomites/): Photography from around the Italian Dolomites (South Tyrol) including Alpe di Siusi, Monte Pez, Seceda and Santa Maddalena.
- [South Highlands](https://mathayward.com/photography/south-highlands/): Photography from The Southern Highlands of Scotland including Ben A’an, Stob Binnein, Ben Each, Monachyle and Loch Dochart.
- [West Coast](https://mathayward.com/photography/west-coast/): Photography from the West Coast of Scotland including the North Coast 500, the Assynt, Torridon, Sandwood Bay, Plockton, Suilven and Stac Pollaidh.
- [Lofoten Islands](https://mathayward.com/photography/lofoten/): Photography from around the Lofoten Islands, Norway including Reine, Henningsvær, Sakrisøya, Storsandnes beach and Hamnøy
- [Lanzarote](https://mathayward.com/photography/lanzarote/): Photography from around Lanzarote, Canary Islands including Timanfaya National Park and El Golfo
- [Tenerife](https://mathayward.com/photography/tenerife/): Photography from around Tenerife, Canary Islands including Mount Teide, Masca Valley, Anaga and Playa de Benijo.
- [The Hebrides](https://mathayward.com/photography/skye-hebrides/): Photography from around Skye and the Hebrides, including the Quiraing, Camasunary Bay, the Cuillin range, Neist Point, Isle of Harris, Isle of Lewis and Isle of Mull.
- [Alberta](https://mathayward.com/photography/alberta/): Photography from around Alberta, Canada, including Banff, Jasper, Kananaskis, Maligne Lake and Peyto Lake.
- [Restaurant Jericho](https://mathayward.com/photography/jericho/): Photography from Restaurant Jericho, a fine dining experience in the Vale of Belvoir.

## Peaks

Write-ups of mountains and hills climbed, newest first.

- [Creag a’ Gheata](https://mathayward.com/peaks/creag-a-gheata/) (October 2026): We decided to get up one of the smaller hills across the road, so texted our friends in the village to see if they wanted to join.
- [Bunking off](https://mathayward.com/peaks/bunking-off/) (October 2026): Yesterday we had one of those beautiful Scottish mornings where the mist is rising from the river and the sun is peeking through the trees. Magical. But on a work day…
- [Two munros; almost as many trees](https://mathayward.com/peaks/ben-lawers/) (August 2026): I’ve not been feeling great recently, so climbing one of Scotland’s highest mountains probably isn’t an obvious choice for a Saturday morning, but we gave it a go anyway.
- [A tale of two Ptarmigans](https://mathayward.com/peaks/a-tale-of-two-ptarmigans/) (May 2026): After a few map calculations, I found the closest Munro to our wedding venue and decided we should tackle that one, to see if we could see it from the top.
- [Unfinished business on Eigg](https://mathayward.com/peaks/unfinished-business-on-eigg/) (May 2026): It’s been thirteen years since we visited Eigg and I’ve been wanting to go back ever since, because of some unfinished business with An Sgurr.
- [Ben Hiant](https://mathayward.com/peaks/ben-hiant/) (April 2026): After a couple of days recovering on the Ardnamurchan peninsula, watching otters, oystercatchers and visiting Sanna Bay, we decided to try a climb up Ben Hiant.
- [Ardnandave](https://mathayward.com/peaks/ardnandave/) (April 2026): I’ve had my eye on Ardnandave Hill since we moved here. Looking at it through the kitchen window, looking all knobbly, awesome and covered in snow over the winter.
- [Meall na Fearna](https://mathayward.com/peaks/meall-na-fearna/) (November 2025): This weekend we’d been forecast good weather on Saturday, so we decided to get back in the swing of things with a mountain walk.
- [Beinn an t-Sìdhean](https://mathayward.com/peaks/beinn-an-t-sidhein/) (November 2025): Having finally settled into our new home in Scotland, we took advantage of a clear, frosty morning to head up Beinn an t-Sìdhean and take in wide views of familiar and not-yet-climbed Munros.
- [West Lawers range](https://mathayward.com/peaks/meall-corranaich-meall-a-choire-leith/) (October 2025): Waiting to move into our new home in the Trossachs, we found a place on Loch Tay to stay for three weeks, so this Sunday we checked out some nearby Munros.
- [Goatfell from Corrie](https://mathayward.com/peaks/goatfell/) (September 2025): After waking up with a sore back from the last hike, we spent a couple of days relaxing before hopping over to Arran in the sunshine to enjoy the beaches and tackle Goatfell.
- [Munro number 15](https://mathayward.com/peaks/maol-chean-dearg/) (September 2025): With the weather being pretty changeable, we decided to go for just the single Munro walk of Maol Chean-dearg.
- [Triple bagging](https://mathayward.com/peaks/sgurr-nan-conbhairean/) (April 2025): After ruling out the 5 Sisters of Kintail and the Brother’s ridge because we’d need a lift, we decided to take on the three Munros to the north of Loch Cluanie.
- [Beinn Each again](https://mathayward.com/peaks/beinn-each-again/) (March 2025): Last weekend we just wanted to get out in the hills so we did an 8-hour drive on Friday evening, camped at Inverlochlarig and then got up to go for a hike around Beinn Each.
- [1974 steps up Reinebringen](https://mathayward.com/peaks/1974-steps-up-reinebringen/) (August 2024): While in Lofoten recently, we decided to do the tourist thing and climb Reinebringen, hoping for a sunset.
- [A beautiful day in Torridon](https://mathayward.com/peaks/a-beautiful-day-in-torridon/) (April 2024): It’s felt like it’s been raining for so long that having a day of sunshine in Torridon was a massive surprise.
- [2.9 peaks of Quinag](https://mathayward.com/peaks/2.9-peaks-of-quinag/) (April 2024): A reminder that mountain weather forecasts aren’t as accurate as you would hope...
- [The easy route up Pico Ruivo](https://mathayward.com/peaks/easy-route-pico-ruivo/) (November 2023): After watching sunset from Pico do Areeiro the evening before, we decided to take a walk to the top of Pico Ruivo to see if the view was better.
- [Canisp and a Covid write-off](https://mathayward.com/peaks/canisp-and-covid/) (September 2022): A plan to bag 16 peaks during a two-week holiday, soon went south.
- [Monte Pez and Rifugio Bolzano](https://mathayward.com/peaks/monte-pez/) (July 2022): After a slow start to peak bagging, I jumped at the opportunity to climb a mountain on holiday in Italy. And a mountain with the promise of lunch at the top is a big win!
- [Fairfield Horseshoe](https://mathayward.com/peaks/fairfield-horseshoe/) (May 2022): A last minute trip to the Lake District gave us the opportunity to check out the Fairfield Horseshoe.
- [Loch Long and Arrochar](https://mathayward.com/peaks/loch-long-the-cobbler/) (April 2022): A wild camp in the woods around Loch Long followed by a walk up The Cobbler on a beautifully clear day.
- [Beinn Each wild camp](https://mathayward.com/peaks/beinn-each-wild-camp/) (March 2022): I kicked off the year with an ‘easy’ climb in the Trossachs. To make it more memorable we set up our first wild camp near the top and watched the sun setting behind Stob Binnein and Ben More.
- [The iconic Suilven](https://mathayward.com/peaks/the-iconic-suilven/) (September 2021): We’ve tried to climb Suilven 3 times. This time we made it!
- [Sunset trip up Cùl Mòr](https://mathayward.com/peaks/sunset-trip-up-cul-mor/) (May 2021): We’ve become obsessed with sunrise and sunset and there’s no better time to be up a mountain.
- [The four peaks of the Buachaille](https://mathayward.com/peaks/the-four-peaks-of-the-buachaille/) (September 2020): I’ve stopped and photographed Stob Dearg just about every time I’ve driven past it.
- [Stac Pollaidh sunrise inversion](https://mathayward.com/peaks/stac-pollaidh-sunrise-inversion/) (September 2020): Getting up at 5am is rarely something I’m happy to do. But it was worth it!
- [Stob Binnein from the south](https://mathayward.com/peaks/stob-binnein-from-the-south/) (September 2019): The first time we visited Scotland, a stranger in a bar told me to try climbing Stob Binnein from the south.
- [Accidental summit of Ben Ledi](https://mathayward.com/peaks/accidental-summit-of-ben-ledi/) (September 2019): A quick dog walk that went a bit further than planned.
